source_reference.quote: Characterization at this step confirms and bounds known relationships. It is not a search for unknown ones.
an effect smaller than about the centre-point standard deviation of its response cannot be separated from run-to-run noise whatever its p-value
the surfaces predict mean levels, so at the boundary of the region the predicted mean sits on the limit and about half of the batches operated exactly there would be expected to exceed it
The step is well understood.
The fit statistics show why this design identifies but does not predict.
Taken with the lack-of-fit tests, this supports the quadratic model form for both attributes.

This is why the operating region for this attribute has to be defined multivariately: a set of one-dimensional ranges, each established with the other parameters at their set-points, would understate the joint effect at the corners of the region.

The design space for this step is the part of the characterized region in the four response-surface factors (culture pH, culture temperature, culture duration and dissolved CO₂) in which every attribute this step governs stays within its in-process limit.
Most characterized ranges are proven acceptable ranges in full when the other factors are held at their set-points, and most are not once the other factors are allowed to move.
The step meets its acceptance criteria at commercial scale with margin on every attribute it forms.
No parameter of this step is classified CPP.
no response shows significant lack of fit against the centre-point pure error
absorbs almost all of the variation in the data and then predicts a held-out run worse than the response mean does

The residual plots show no structure against the predicted value and no funnel, the normal quantile plots are close to linear over the body of the distribution, and the actual against predicted plots scatter about the identity line without curvature.
The predicted coefficient of determination is the measure that matters for a design space, because it is computed by leaving each run out in turn
so no simulated batch came within a percentage point of either limit
Since the whole of that range is a proven acceptable range for every attribute (§7), it is classified as well controlled on that basis and not on ease of control alone.

Elevated dissolved CO₂ lowers the pH of the Golgi lumen and moves the transferase away from its optimum, and a higher culture pH shifts the ammonium equilibrium towards free ammonia, which crosses membranes readily and raises lumenal pH with the same consequence.
The strong pH by duration interaction follows from that shared mechanism, because two conditions that both restrict the same limited galactosylation capacity cannot each remove it in full.
so it is a real term in the model that is too small to matter to the control strategy
it is reported as one check among four and not as the sole basis of model acceptance

The screening results below are read as a ranking of active factors and as evidence of their direction, while the magnitudes used for prediction and for the design space come from the response-surface model
The other four attributes remove further parts of the cube, and none of them is negligible.
Three bounds apply to this claim.
Where the whole characterization range is a proven acceptable range, as it is here, the binding constraint on the operating region is the multivariate corner and not any univariate range.

Host cell protein (HCP) and residual DNA are generated here and cleared downstream, so their drug substance capability is credited to Protein A chromatography, cation exchange and anion exchange, and the aggregate formed here is polished at cation exchange.
The credit for those two figures belongs to Protein A chromatography, cation exchange and anion exchange, and it is claimed in PCR-005, PCR-007 and PCR-008.

The step also makes no contribution to viral safety, since clearance of enveloped and non-enveloped virus is claimed at low-pH inactivation, anion exchange and virus filtration, and the cumulative claim is consolidated in PCMR-001.
Both were investigated, impact-assessed and retained, and neither changed a parameter classification or the boundary of the operating region.
